'''Jiří Drahoš'''  (born 20 February 1949; {{IPA|cs|ˈjɪr̝iː ˈdraɦoʃ}}) is a Czech [[Physical chemistry|physical chemist]] and politician who has been the [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Senator]] of [[Prague 4]] since October 2018. Previously, Drahoš served as President of the [[Czech Academy of Sciences]] from 2009 to 2017, and was a candidate in the [[2018 Czech presidential election]].

Born in [[Český Těšín]] and raised in nearby [[Jablunkov]], Drahoš studied physical chemistry at the [[University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague|University of Chemistry and Technology]] in Prague, and joined the [[Institute of Chemical Process Fundamentals]] of the [[Czechoslovak Academy of Sciences]] in 1973, which he later led from 1995 to 2003. In 2009, he was elected President of the Czech Academy of Sciences. His term as head of the academy ended on 24 March 2017.

In March 2017, Drahoš announced his candidacy for [[President of the Czech Republic]] in the [[2018 Czech presidential election|2018 election]]. He ran on a moderate [[Centrism|centrist]] platform, and is generally [[Pro-Europeanism|pro-European]] and supportive of [[NATO]] and [[Atlanticism]]. Drahoš lost the second round of the presidential election to his opponent President [[Miloš Zeman]] with 48.6% of the vote, but vowed to remain in public life. In October 2018, he stood for the [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Czech Senate]] in the Prague 4 district, winning [[2018 Czech Senate election|the election]] outright in the first round with 52.65% of the vote.<ref name="Výsledky hlasování {{!}} volby.cz">{{Cite web|url=https://www.volby.cz/pls/senat/se2111?xjazyk=CZ&xdatum=20181005&xobvod=20|title=Výsledky hlasování {{!}} volby.cz|website=www.volby.cz|language=cs|access-date=2018-10-07}}</ref><ref name="senatewin">{{cite news|url=http://praguemonitor.com/2018/10/08/former-presidential-candidate-draho%C5%A1-wins-senate-race-first-round|website=Prague Daily Monitor|date=8 October 2018|access-date=8 October 2018|title=Former presidential candidate Drahoš wins senate race in first round|archive-date=8 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181008084811/http://praguemonitor.com/2018/10/08/former-presidential-candidate-draho%C5%A1-wins-senate-race-first-round|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He is a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members |url=https://members.euro-acad.eu/#memberList |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=members.euro-acad.eu}}</ref>

==Early life and career==
Jiří Drahoš was born on 20 February 1949 in [[Český Těšín]] to a Czech father originally from [[Skuteč]] in [[Vysočina Region|Vysočina]], and a [[Polish minority in the Czech Republic|Polish]] mother from Jablunkov.<ref>{{cite news |last= Schönwald |first= Beata |date= 23 January 2018 |title= Mój brat może być wzorem dla innych |url= http://glos.live/Wiadomosci/detail/Moj_brat_moze_byc_wzorem_dla_innych/#i151670091941 |work= [[Głos Ludu|Głos]] |access-date= 30 January 2018 }}</ref> He spent most of his childhood in [[Jablunkov]], where his mother Anna lived and worked as a nurse. His father, also named Jiří, was a teacher in a local Czech school.

Drahoš studied at the [[University of Chemistry and Technology, Prague|University of Chemistry and Technology]] in Prague and qualified as a scientist in 1972. He joined the [[Institute of Chemical Process Fundamentals]] at the [[Czech Academy of Sciences]], and was later head of the institute from 1996 to 2003.<ref>{{cite web|title=prof. Ing. Jiří Drahoš, DrSc., dr. h. c. - Akademie věd České republiky|url=http://www.avcr.cz/cs/o-nas/struktura/akademicka-rada-av-cr/seznam-clenu-akademicke-rady-av-cr/prof.-ing.-jiri-drahos-drsc.-dr.-h.-c./|website=www.avcr.cz|access-date=28 February 2017|language=cs|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170313124340/http://www.avcr.cz/cs/o-nas/struktura/akademicka-rada-av-cr/seznam-clenu-akademicke-rady-av-cr/prof.-ing.-jiri-drahos-drsc.-dr.-h.-c./|archive-date=13 March 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> On 13 March 2009, Drahoš was elected President of the [[Czech Academy of Sciences]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Novým předsedou Akademie věd se stal Jiří Drahoš|url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/163792-novym-predsedou-akademie-ved-se-stal-jiri-drahos.html|website=Novinky.cz|date=13 March 2009 |access-date=28 February 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> defeating [[Eva Syková]]. During his tenure, he successfully opposed 50% budget cuts to the Academy proposed by the governments of Prime Ministers [[Mirek Topolánek's Second Cabinet|Mirek Topolánek]] and [[Jan Fischer's Cabinet|Jan Fischer]] as a consequence of the [[2008 financial crisis]]. Drahoš later called it an "attempt to destroy my motherly institution".<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://demagog.cz/vyrok/16084|title=Factcheck politických diskuzí|last=Demagog.cz|access-date=2018-01-19|language=cs}}</ref> In 2012, President [[Václav Klaus]] awarded him the [[Medal of Merit (Czech Republic)|Medal of Merit]] in the field of science. His second term as head of the academy ended on 24 March 2017. He is co-author of 14 patents.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://zpravy.e15.cz/jiri-drahos-volba-prezidenta-2018|title=Prezidentské volby 2018 – kandidát Jiří Drahoš - E15.cz|work=Zprávy E15.cz|access-date=2017-12-19}}</ref>

==Political career==
===2018 presidential campaign===
On 28 March 2017, Drahoš announced his intention to stand in the [[2018 Czech presidential election|2018 presidential election]].<ref name="Drahoš oznámil kandidaturu na prezidenta">{{cite web|title=Drahoš oznámil kandidaturu na prezidenta|url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/433477-drahos-oznamil-kandidaturu-na-prezidenta.html|website=Novinky.cz|date=28 March 2017 |access-date=27 May 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> On 24 April 2017, he started gathering the signatures required to be registered as a candidate.<ref name="Drahoš začal sbírat podpisy. Má 500 dobrovolníků, zapojí i pěvce - Echo24.cz">{{cite web|title=Drahoš začal sbírat podpisy. Má 500 dobrovolníků, zapojí i pěvce|url=http://echo24.cz/a/iyTYU/drahoszacal-sbirat-podpisy-ma-500-dobrovolniku-zapoji-i-pevce|website=Echo24.cz|access-date=27 May 2017|language=cs-CZ|date=24 April 2017}}</ref> In July 2017, after meeting with Drahoš, the leaders of [[Populars and Mayors]], [[Pavel Bělobrádek]] and [[Petr Gazdík]], announced that they would ask their respective parties' members to nominate and endorse Drahoš's candidacy. [[Mayors and Independents]] endorsed Drahoš on 25 July 2017 while the [[Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party]] (KDU–ČSL) endorsed him on 14 November 2017.<ref name="Hnutí STAN podporuje kandidaturu Jiřího Drahoše na prezidenta">{{cite web|title=Hnutí STAN podporuje kandidaturu Jiřího Drahoše na prezidenta|url=http://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/hnuti-stan-podporuje-kandidaturu-jiriho-drahose-na-prezidenta/1509946|website=www.ceskenoviny.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|language=cs}}</ref><ref name="Lidovci vyzvali své voliče, aby v souboji o Hrad podpořili Drahoše">{{cite web|title=Lidovci vyzvali své voliče, aby v souboji o Hrad podpořili Drahoše|url=https://zpravy.idnes.cz/kdu-csl-lidovci-jiri-drahos-podpora-prezident-volba-fho-/domaci.aspx?c=A171114_191324_domaci_ane|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=14 November 2017}}</ref> [[Young Social Democrats (Czech Republic)|Young Social Democrats]] also endorsed Drahoš on 9 December 2017.<ref name="Mladí sociální demokraté volí Jiřího Drahoše">{{cite web|title=Mladí sociální demokraté volí Jiřího Drahoše|url=https://www.cssd.cz/media/tiskove-zpravy/mladi-socialni-demokrate-voli-jiriho-drahose/|website=ČSSD|access-date=16 January 2018}}</ref> Polls in late 2017 showed Drahoš as the second strongest candidate behind Zeman.<ref name="Volební průzkumy - preference kandidátů na prezidenta 2018 - Reflex.cz">{{cite web|title=Volební průzkumy - preference kandidátů na prezidenta 2018 - Reflex.cz|url=http://www.reflex.cz/pruzkum-prezidentske-volby-2018|website=Reflex.cz|date=19 December 2017 |access-date=22 December 2017|language=cs}}</ref><ref name="Průzkum: Drahoš by Zemana ve 2. kole prezidentských voleb těsně porazil">{{cite web|title=Průzkum: Drahoš by Zemana ve 2. kole prezidentských voleb těsně porazil|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/pruzkum-median-drahos-zeman-d1j-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A171107_135541_domaci_jj|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=7 November 2017}}</ref>

Drahoš received campaign donations from several influential businessmen, including [[Dalibor Dědek]], [[Jiří Grygar]] and [[Luděk Sekyra]].<ref name="Kolem Drahoše se rýsují výrazní podporovatelé, hlásí se Dědek či Grygar">{{cite web|title=Kolem Drahoše se rýsují výrazní podporovatelé, hlásí se Dědek či Grygar|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/jiri-drahos-kandidat-na-prezidenta-podporovatele-dalibor-dedek-jiri-grygar-1uw-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A170323_214318_domaci_ekl|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=24 March 2017}}</ref><ref name="Jiří Drahoš dostal 1,5 milionu od jednoho z největších českých filantropů  - Seznam Zprávy">{{cite web|title=Jiří Drahoš dostal 1,5 milionu od jednoho z největších českých filantropů|url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/clanek/jiri-drahos-dostal-15-milionu-od-jednoho-z-nejvetsich-ceskych-filantropu-39814|website=www.seznamzpravy.cz|date=14 November 2017 |access-date=22 December 2017}}</ref> Drahoš started gathering signatures for his nomination in May 2017.<ref name="Podepište. Jak Zeman, Drahoš a Horáček sbírají příznivce k cestě na Hrad">{{cite web|title=Podepište. Jak Zeman, Drahoš a Horáček sbírají příznivce k cestě na Hrad|url=https://zlin.idnes.cz/kandidati-na-hrad-sbiraji-podpisy-pod-prezidentskou-kandidaturu-pxh-/zlin-zpravy.aspx?c=A170530_2329331_zlin-zpravy_ppr|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=30 May 2017}}</ref> On 19 August 2017, Drahoš announced he had gathered 78,000 signatures.<ref name="Drahoš v námořnickém tričku děkoval za 78 321 podpisů pro boj o Hrad">{{cite web|title=Drahoš v námořnickém tričku děkoval za 78 321 podpisů pro boj o Hrad|url=https://zpravy.idnes.cz/drahos-podpisy-hrad-kandidatura-dobrovolnici-setkani-pfe-/domaci.aspx?c=A170819_133901_domaci_kop|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=19 August 2017}}</ref> He submitted his nomination on 3 November 2017 with 142,000 signatures.<ref name="Drahoš předal 142 tisíc podpisů a několikrát se vymezil proti Zemanovi">{{cite web|title=Drahoš předal 142 tisíc podpisů a několikrát se vymezil proti Zemanovi|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/drrahos-volba-prezidenta-predani-podpisu-na-vnitro-fxx-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A171103_085900_domaci_kop|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=3 November 2017}}</ref>

On 4 November 2017 on Facebook, Drahoš criticized [[Mirek Topolánek]], who had announced his candidacy that day, describing Topolánek as similar to Miloš Zeman and calling his candidacy a bad joke.<ref name="Drahoš zbytečně napadl Topolánka. Babiš mu nevadí?">{{cite web|title=Drahoš zbytečně napadl Topolánka. Babiš mu nevadí?|url=http://forum24.cz/drahos-zbytecne-napadl-topolanka-babis-mu-nevadi/|website=Forum 24|access-date=22 December 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> The two candidates met during a presidential debate at [[Charles University]]; Drahoš reflected that the status he posted was "Topolánek-like", to which Topolánek replied that it was written either by "a woman or PR mage".<ref name="Hrad by to chtělo vydezinfikovat, řekl Horáček v debatě kandidátů">{{cite web|title=Hrad by to chtělo vydezinfikovat, řekl Horáček v debatě kandidátů|url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/454421-hrad-by-to-chtelo-vydezinfikovat-rekl-horacek-v-debate-kandidatu.html|website=Novinky.cz|date=8 November 2017 |access-date=22 December 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref>

Drahoš received media attention when he expressed his fear that the election could be influenced by Russia. He met outgoing Prime Minister [[Bohuslav Sobotka]] to discuss the matter and stated he would also meet the new Prime Minister [[Andrej Babiš]].<ref name="Dezinformace od cizích tajných služeb ovlivňují české volby, míní Drahoš">{{cite web|title=Dezinformace od cizích tajných služeb ovlivňují české volby, míní Drahoš|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/drahos-ovlivnovani-voleb-tajne-sluzby-dyj-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A171201_104818_domaci_linv|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=1 December 2017}}</ref> The incumbent president [[Miloš Zeman]] criticized Drahoš and compared his actions to [[Hillary Clinton]]'s when she lost to [[Donald Trump]].<ref name="Drahoš se chová jako Clintonová během prezidentských voleb, řekl Zeman">{{cite web|title=Drahoš se chová jako Clintonová během prezidentských voleb, řekl Zeman|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/navsteva-jizni-moravy-prezident-milos-zeman-fnc-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A171201_123234_brno-zpravy_vh|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=1 December 2017}}</ref>

Drahoš received criticism when he published a status on social media about [[Václav Klaus]]' amnesty, when it was revealed that he had copied a similar status by his fellow presidential candidate [[Michal Horáček]]. Drahoš apologised and attributed the mistake to an external member of staff.<ref name="Drahoš opsal Horáčkovy citace a sklidil posměch na sociálních sítích">{{cite web|title=Drahoš opsal Horáčkovy citace a sklidil posměch na sociálních sítích|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/prezidentske-volby-kampan-jiri-drahos-micha-horacek-socialni-site-1c5-/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?c=A171220_142614_domaci_bja|website=iDNES.cz|access-date=22 December 2017|date=20 December 2017}}</ref>

The first round was held on 12 and 13 January 2018. Drahoš received 1,369,601 (26.6%) votes,<ref>{{cite web|title=Výsledky Jiřího Drahoše|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/?k=vysledky-prvni-kolo&t=8&o=9&kandidat=jiri-drahos|website=Idnes.cz|access-date=17 January 2018|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> and advanced to the second round against the incumbent president [[Miloš Zeman]].<ref name="Zeman opanoval první kolo, vyzyvatelem je Drahoš">{{cite web|title=Zeman opanoval první kolo, vyzyvatelem je Drahoš|url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/460392-zeman-opanoval-prvni-kolo-vyzyvatelem-je-drahos.html|website=Novinky.cz|date=13 January 2018 |access-date=14 January 2018|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> In the second round, held on 26–27 January 2018, Drahoš received 48.63% of the vote and thus lost to Zeman.<ref>{{cite web|title=Výsledky Jiřího Drahoše|url=https://volby.idnes.cz/prezidentske-volby-2018.aspx?k=vysledky-druhe-kolo&t=8&o=9&kandidat=jiri-drahos|website=Idnes.cz|access-date=27 January 2018|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> Drahoš conceded defeat to Zeman, telling a crowd of his supporters that "I would like to congratulate election winner Miloš Zeman".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/27/czech-president-milos-zeman-wins-second-term|title=Czech president Miloš Zeman wins second five-year term|last=Prague|first=Associated Press in|date=2018-01-27|website=the Guardian|language=en|access-date=2018-01-28}}</ref>

===Senate===
Following the 2018 presidential election, Drahoš vowed to remain in public life, and in March 2018 announced his bid for the Prague 4 [[Senate of the Czech Republic|Senate]] seat in the [[2018 Czech Senate election|2018 election]], nominated by [[Mayors and Independents]] and supported by [[TOP 09]], KDU–ČSL and the [[Green Party (Czech Republic)|Green Party]].<ref name="Drahoš získal pro volby do Senátu v Praze podporu ze čtyř stran">{{cite web |title=Drahoš získal pro volby do Senátu v Praze podporu ze čtyř stran |url=https://zpravy.idnes.cz/drahos-kandidatura-senat-podpora-kdu-csl-top-09-stan-zeleni-p3y-/domaci.aspx?c=A180531_215616_domaci_kop |website=iDNES.cz |access-date=19 August 2018 |date=1 June 2018}}</ref> He won [[2018 Czech Senate election|the election]] outright in the first round, with 52.65% of the vote.<ref name="Výsledky hlasování {{!}} volby.cz"/><ref name="senatewin"/>

At the beginning of November 2022, Drahoš was elected 1st Deputy President of the Czech Senate replacing [[Jiří Růžička (politician)|Jiří Růžička]], having received 67 out of 80 votes in a secret ballot.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-11-02 |title=Předsedou Senátu se stal opět Vystrčil. Místopředsedy jsou Czernin, Drahoš, Oberfalzer a Seitlová |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/miloes-vystrcil-senat-predseda-volba_2211021116_ako |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=iROZHLAS |language=cs}}</ref>

In the [[2024 Czech Senate election]]s, he defended his seat as a non-party member of STAN in Senate District No.20 - Prague 4, with the support of STAN, Pirates, ODS, KDU-ČSL and TOP 09.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Oppelt |first=Robert |date=2024-06-24 |title=STAN odhalil jména pro senátní volby. Mandát chtějí bývalí prezidentští kandidáti |url=https://www.idnes.cz/nastaveni-souhlasu?url=https%3a%2f%2fwww.idnes.cz%2fvolby%2fsenat-volby-vit-rakusan-jiri-drahos.A240624_110006_domaci_row |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=iDNES.cz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=S podporou STAN bude do Senátu kandidovat 16 lidí, tři z nich mandát obhajují |url=https://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/2535696 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=ČeskéNoviny.cz  |language=cs}}</ref> He won the first round of the election, receiving 48.21% of the vote. On 30 October 2024, he was re-elected as the 1st Deputy President of the Senate, with 61 votes from the 79 senators present.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-30 |title=Senát dál povede Vystrčil. Místopředsedy se stali Drahoš, Oberfalzer, Seitlová a Václavec |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/milos-vystrcil-predseda-senatu-senat-ods_2410301214_ako |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=iROZHLAS |language=cs}}</ref>

==Political views==
Drahoš considers himself a [[Centrism|centrist]] politician. As a candidate, Jiří Drahoš has presented himself as someone who can unite society, and as a respectable person who would act according to the [[Constitution of the Czech Republic|constitution]]. Drahoš emphasises the importance of Czech science and education and has called for solidarity with those "who cannot take care of themselves".<ref>{{cite web|title=Kundra: The signals of Jiří Drahoš|url=https://www.respekt.cz/tydenik/2017/50/signaly-jiriho-drahose/|access-date=6 January 2018|language=cs}}</ref><ref name=candwebsite/> He has called for a "responsible approach" to the landscape and environment and has described human reason, creativity and ingeniousness as the only "renewable resource" of the wealth of the Czech Republic.<ref name=candwebsite>{{cite web|title=Jiří Drahoš - official website|url=https://www.jiridrahos.cz/|access-date=6 January 2018|language=cs}}</ref>

Drahoš wants the Czech Republic to play an active role in discussions over the future of the [[European Union]], and wants the country to be a part of the [[Western world]].<ref name="Drahoš: O závažných věcech, jako je členství v EU, by se nemělo hlasovat v referendu" /> He supports [[European integration]] but has said that he believes that the European Union should not impose unnecessary [[Regulation (European Union)|regulations]] on member states. He also said that he would not rush into [[Czech Republic and the euro|Czech adoption of the Euro]].<ref name="VIDEO: S přijetím eura bych raději ještě vyčkal, říká v rozhovoru prezidentský kandidát Jiří Drahoš">{{cite web|title=VIDEO: S přijetím eura bych raději ještě vyčkal, říká v rozhovoru prezidentský kandidát Jiří Drahoš|url=https://www.web4trader.cz/video-s-prijetim-eura-bych-radeji-jeste-vyckal-rika-v-rozhovoru-prezidentsky-kandidat-jiri-drahos/|website=Web4Trader|access-date=26 May 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> Drahoš opposes a [[Euroscepticism in the Czech Republic|referendum about Czech membership of the European Union]], and said that important geopolitical questions should not be decided by referendum.<ref name="Drahoš: O závažných věcech, jako je členství v EU, by se nemělo hlasovat v referendu">{{cite web|title=Drahoš: O závažných věcech, jako je členství v EU, by se nemělo hlasovat v referendu|url=https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/442298-drahos-o-zavaznych-vecech-jako-je-clenstvi-v-eu-by-se-nemelo-hlasovat-v-referendu.html|website=Novinky.cz|date=29 June 2017 |access-date=29 June 2017|language=cs-CZ}}</ref> He supports the Czech Republic's membership of [[NATO]].

In August 2015, Drahoš signed a petition named "scientists against fear and apathy" in opposition to both anti-Islamic radicalism and anti-immigrant populism.<ref>{{cite news|title=Jiří Drahoš: Vědci, kteří nesouhlasí s naší výzvou, se jen rádi vymezují|url=http://www.rozhlas.cz/dvojka/jaktovidi/_zprava/jiri-drahos-vedci-kteri-nesouhlasi-s-nasi-vyzvou-se-jen-radi-vymezuji-a-to-proti-cemukoli--1535545|access-date=16 January 2018|work=Dvojka|agency=Český rozhlas}}</ref>

Drahoš suggested that the [[2017 Catalan independence referendum|Catalan independence referendum]] was "not legal", supporting the position of the [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Čeští politici odmítají násilí při katalánském referendu |url=http://www.ceskenoviny.cz/zpravy/cesti-politici-odmitaji-nasili-pri-katalanskem-referendu/1533508 |website=Ceskenoviny.cz |date=10 October 2018|language=cs-CZ}}</ref>

In 2017, Drahoš said he supports the [[International sanctions during the Ukrainian crisis|sanctions against Russia]] imposed by the United States and the EU.<ref name="russia">{{cite web|title=Nevidím důvod pro rušení sankcí proti Rusku, říká prezidentský kandidát Jiří Drahoš |url=http://zpravy.e15.cz/domaci/politika/nevidim-duvod-pro-ruseni-sankci-proti-rusku-rika-prezidentsky-kandidat-jiri-drahos-1331135 |website=Zpravy.e15.cz |date=14 April 2017| language=cs-CZ}}</ref> However he also said that having good relations with [[Russia]] is in the interest of the Czech Republic and European Union.<ref name="russia"/> Drahoš supports trade and economic relations with [[China]], arguing that "China is a superpower" and "many countries are doing business with China."<ref>{{cite web|title=Drahoš po prvním kole: Ruské tajné služby usilují o znovuzvolení Miloše Zemana |url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/volby/prezdientske-volby-2018-jiri-drahos-rozhovor_1801141745_jgr |website=irozhlas.cz |date=14 January 2018 | language=cs-CZ}}</ref>

In 2017, Drahoš rejected the European Union's proposal of [[European migrant crisis#Relocation and resettlement of asylum seekers|compulsory migrant quotas]], saying, "there is no successful model of [[Islam in Europe|Muslim]] [[Social integration|integration]] in Europe".<ref name="immigration">{{cite web|title=Foto: "Ještě není politik, odpovídá na otázky". Drahoš zahájil kampaň, města objíždí s manželkou |url=https://zpravy.aktualne.cz/domaci/foto-jeste-neni-politik-odpovida-na-otazky-drahos-zahajil-ka/r~0b3fef98688111e7bc9f002590604f2e/r~f137227c687811e7bc2d0025900fea04/ |website=Aktualne.cz |date=14 July 2017| language=cs-CZ}}</ref> Drahoš also said that "Europe can't feed 100 million Africans, it is necessary to help them at home."<ref name="immigration"/>

Drahoš described the pre-war [[Germans in Czechoslovakia (1918–1938)|German minority]] in [[Czechoslovakia]] as "Adolf Hitler's fifth column", and said that he agreed with the post-war [[expulsion of Germans from Czechoslovakia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Drahoš odmítá megakanál, po němž touží Zeman, i evropský superstát |url=http://zpravy.idnes.cz/nazory-jiriho-drahose-v-knize-veda-zije-fcd-/domaci.aspx?c=A170403_101724_domaci_kop |website=iDNES.cz |date=3 April 2017| language=cs-CZ}}</ref>

Drahoš has described himself as a sympathizer with [[Israel]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Foto: "Ještě není politik, odpovídá na otázky". Drahoš zahájil kampaň, města objíždí s manželkou |url=https://zpravy.aktualne.cz/domaci/foto-jeste-neni-politik-odpovida-na-otazky-drahos-zahajil-ka/r~0b3fef98688111e7bc9f002590604f2e/r~dfd8ea24687811e7986b0025900fea04/ |website=Aktualne.cz |date=14 July 2017| language=cs-CZ}}</ref>
